name: Translate
summary: Live two-way translated calls. Each person hears the other in a voice that sounds like them, speaking the other language. Captions for both directions, and an optional saved meeting with original audio, a bilingual transcript and evidence-linked notes. All processing stays on this Mac.
capabilities: Translates a one-to-one call in both directions with recognizable voices
Shows original and translated captions for both people
Optionally saves original audio, a bilingual transcript and notes that cite their sources
Owns its own audio routing, models, voice profiles and meeting storage
